name: Fallen
description: When you die, your items don't scatter and vanish. Your body stays where you fell — a corpse wearing your skin — holding everything you were carrying, plus your XP. It settles on the ground and floats on lava or water so nothing is left out of reach. Walk back and right-click to reclaim it (sneak-right-click takes everything), and a full inventory never spills your loot. A body is yours until it ages into a skeleton, then anyone can loot it; left too long, it drops its contents so nothing is ever truly lost. Optional Trinkets support. Original code and assets.
